title: Dragon Dad Rebuild
author: YURIY K.
desc:
Dragon Dad Rebuild is for guys over 50 who can still touch their toes — technically, if "lunging violently at the floor while the room spins" counts. It was built by AI and checked against real exercise science: progressive overload, RIR-based intensity, and actual hinge, carry, and single-leg work, not just a kettlebell and vibes. The twenty-four weeks collapse into eight repeatable week-templates across three phases — Base Build, Strength & Volume, and Capacity — so you never have to memorize 168 individual days, just "which week am I in." Every week pairs kettlebell strength work with a Thursday mobility session:

- Cat cow spine wave
- Standing wave
- Deep squat hold
- Low dragon
- Cossack shifts
- Split-stance lunge hold
- Spinal twist

Pulled straight from actual Shaolin monk stretches, because nothing builds character like holding a "low dragon" in your living room while your kids ask if you're okay. Deload weeks land every fourth week whether your ego wants them or not, test weeks check whether any of it's working, and every set has an RPE target so "3x8" means something more than "I did some pushups, I think." The goal isn't turning you into a 25-year-old — it's turning you into the strongest, most mobile version of the guy who'll be picking his kid up off the floor for the next twenty years, and can still get back up himself.
